# Fa Guides — Persian Condensed Tech Guides

**[Fa Guides](https://github.com/Godde3s/fa-guides)** is my contribution to the Persian-language technical canon: two dense, beautiful, **fully interactive** guides — [Hermes Agent 2.0](https://godde3s.github.io/fa-guides/) and Node.js Design Patterns — condensed to ~12 minutes of reading each, with active-recall quizzes at the end.

## What makes them different

- **Single self-contained file** — the Vazirmatn font ships inside the HTML; everything renders perfectly offline, even from `file://`.
- **True RTL typography** — Persian-first layout, responsive for mobile, done properly rather than mirrored-at-the-end.
- **Interactive self-testing** — expandable quiz answers implement active recall, the study technique that actually sticks.
- **Light/dark themes** — `D` toggles theme, `T` toggles the outline; choices persist.
- **A real problem→pattern table** — the Node.js guide maps everyday backend problems to the pattern that solves them.

Content-wise this sits at the intersection of everything I do: deep technical reading, Persian-first design, and the publishing infrastructure to make knowledge accessible — plus the discipline of condensing two books without losing their spine.
